text.text_excerpt: We have stayed at this location three times- the first two being while renovations were occurring. Those are complete now and the rooms are pretty, yet modern. The staff is still wonderful- friendly, efficient, and willing to help with anything patrons need. We were given a room with two queen beds overlooking Canal Street, which was touted as a huge selling point, but for us, it was way too loud. We had trouble sleeping because of the sounds coming from Canal and the French Quarter, plus the police/ambulance/fire truck sirens. Also, I don't remember the walls between rooms being so thin, but around 11pm our last night, we could hear the kids in the room next to ours having a pillow fight...

Great Hotel!! Pictures online did this place absolute no justice. Beautiful rooms and nice views. Very clean, and employees were extremely nice and caring. Very quiet hotel with zero complaints. JW Marriott attended to all my needs to make my birthday/anniversary trip great. Bed was comfortable, shower was great, spacious king size rooms. Attached is a Fogo De Chao, right outside is Cafe Beignet, and walking distance from Bourbon St, CVS, and a NOLA staple Ruby Slipper and so much more. Great location; never had to call an uber/lyft or taxi.

This was my 1st stay at this hotel. It's in a great location on Canal St near Royal. The room was quite nice and had a great view of the skyline and the MS river (see photos). I did uber over the weekend but valet parking is available. Amenities are abundant and include a pool and concierge room - gym is under renovation, but you can access the gym at the Sheraton which is nearby. There are several shops in the vicinity and you can walk to Bourbon St in minutes. I plan on revisiting.
